EmailTemplate.subject: Memphis Invest- Q4 2017 Investment Timeline
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
I'm reaching out to all of my clients this week as we head into the last 60 days of 2017 to see who is still looking to add another property or properties to their portfolio before the end of the year.
If you are looking to acquire a property in either Memphis, Dallas, or Houston, please reply to this email and let me know asap so that I can find a property for you that matches your investment criteria.
Remember, Memphis properties are typically $110K-150k with a rare few coming in between $90-100k (no conventional financing on those), and Dallas and Houston are usually $160-200k although we do get a few in Texas between $140-160k on occasion.
If you want me to be on the lookout for a property for you before the end of the year, please reply to this email with the following info:
1. Do you have a market preference (Memphis, Dallas, or Houston)?
2. What purchase method will you be using (Cash, Conventional financing, or non-recourse financing for your IRA/ solo-401k)?
3. Do you have a preferred price point?
4. What is your total budget to allocate towards your next property.
5. Is there any other investment criteria that I need to know?
Once I receive this information from you, I will reach out to schedule a call with you in the next few days to make sure we are on the same page with what properties I will be looking for that would be a good fit for you.
Looking forward to hearing back from you, and to helping you finish off 2017 strong!
Sincerely,
Ashley ---------
